steps.text: Open the dossier whose filing you want to record.
steps.title: Open the dossier

steps.text: While the dossier is "In preparation", the regulator expects nothing from you. The buttons at the top only offer the status changes that make sense at this stage.
steps.title: A dossier in preparation

steps.text: You file the dossier with the authority through your usual channel; here you record that the filing happened.
steps.title: Mark the dossier as submitted

steps.text: The filing date is not a formality: it is what starts the regulatory clocks. Pick the date the dossier was really filed.
steps.title: The filing date

steps.text: Confirm to record the status change.
steps.title: Confirm the transition

steps.text: The status changes and the available actions change with it: a submitted dossier can be declared complete, corrected, or lapse.
steps.title: The dossier is submitted

steps.text: The "Deadlines" tab shows what the filing has just triggered.
steps.title: See the deadlines

steps.text: You never enter a deadline by hand: OptimCE derives it from the dossier type, the region and the date you have just recorded.
steps.title: A deadline has appeared

steps.text: Go back to the list of dossiers.
steps.title: Back to the list

steps.text: The "Deadlines" tab of the main page gathers the deadlines of every dossier, so you can see at a glance what is coming due.
steps.title: Every deadline

steps.text: Every row links back to its dossier and shows the due date. The filter shows the still-open deadlines by default.
steps.title: The deadline board

steps.text: Once the obligation is fulfilled, mark the deadline as met. It leaves the open list without disappearing from the record.
steps.title: Close a deadline

steps.text: Confirm: the deadline moves to "Met" and the open-deadline board empties.
steps.title: Confirm

steps.text: The board shows no open deadline any more. The dossier history still keeps a record of what was done and when.
steps.title: Nothing pending

title: File a dossier and follow its deadline
